note: Dual clock: CIO narrative buckets + ops aging thresholds. Stale is a visible failure.

labels.stale: > 8h (loud visual failure — red/amber border + STALE badge)

cio_buckets.Stale: ops failure / past useful cadence — treat as loud failure
cio_buckets.Live: Contested decision max — not Settled; awaiting next_receipt or leg death

alignment: Breaking maps to ops fresh. Developing spans ops aging through mid-day. Settled is older than 24h but may still be tracked. Stale (CIO or ops >8h without refresh) triggers STALE badge + border.

contested_cap.rule: While Contested/null: freshness_bucket may be Breaking, Developing, or Live; preferred=Live; Settled forbidden
